# Guangzhou Phone Farm (phonefarm.cn)

> Phone farm hardware manufacturer in Guangzhou, China - RFQ-based sales, not retail checkout.

## Brand

Guangzhou Phone Farm (广州手机农场) supplies real-device phone farm boxes, Android motherboard arrays, multi-device chassis, network gear, ROM customization and remote setup support.

## Products

- Android Motherboard Box (20 nodes)
- 32PCS Phone Farm Box
- 12PCS Phone Array (hot-swap)
- iPhone Farm Box (custom quote)
- Network router / switch for OTG-LAN
- Accessories: USB hub, power, cooling, empty chassis
- OEM custom cabinet
- Remote setup service

## Sales Model

- **RFQ only** on website - Get Quote / WhatsApp / Email
- Pricing depends on configuration - contact for bulk quote
- Sample orders available
- For confirmed bulk orders, payment methods discussed with sales (bank transfer, USDT when applicable)

## Technical Specs (typical motherboard box)

- 20 nodes, 55x38x16 cm, ~7 kg, 220V ~100W
- USB + OTG/LAN dual mode
- 1 PC controls 3-5 boxes (software dependent)

## Use

Hardware for development, testing, device management and legitimate automation integration.
